problemStatement.formal: f₃(n) = o(3^n) where f₃(n) = max cap set size in {0,1,2}^n
problemStatement.plain: Is f₃(n) = o(3^n)? YES - proved via density Hales-Jewett theorem.
whyMatters: Central problem in additive combinatorics (cap set problem)
Connected to sunflower conjecture, matrix multiplication exponents
Breakthrough by Ellenberg-Gijswijt (2016) using polynomial method

proven: f₃(1) = 2 (proved: upper bound from pigeonhole, lower bound from pair)
f₃(n) ≥ 1 for all n (singleton cap set)
Subsets of cap sets are cap sets
Full set of {0,1,2}^1 is not a cap set
